column1: You ponder her query for a few minutes before responding, "Set the KF Console to ACTIVE and we will use a Pirate Point for our next jump."\n\n The KF Console is now ACTIVE.
column2: 你思索了几分钟她的问题，然后回答道：“把 KF 控制台设为 启用，我们下一次跳跃就使用海盗跳跃点。”\n\n KF 控制台当前状态：启用。

column1: You rub your temples for a moment, "I just cannot see the logic in blindly replacing a possibly good part.  We'll just have to adjust to dealing with this random knocking noise.  At least it's not happening all the time."\n\nDr Murad nods and instructs her team of astechs to begin to reassemble the panels of the Console.  As they work, she turns back to you, "I'll let you know when whichver faulty component finally fails and takes the Console fully offline."
column2: 你揉了揉太阳穴：“我实在看不出盲目更换一个可能完好的部件有什么道理。看来只能先适应这阵随机出现的敲击声了。至少它不是一直响个不停。”\n\n穆拉德博士点点头，指示技术员们开始重新装回控制台面板。工作期间，她转身对你说道：“等哪个故障部件最终彻底失效、让控制台完全下线时，我会通知你。”

column1: Introduced in the late 31st Century on Solaris VII, the Combat Shield is a movable piece of armor that can be mounted on BattleMechs. The shield was first introduced as a method to add protection for a MechWarrior fighting in the arenas of Solaris. Shields are primary defensive equipment used to protect a 'Mech from Weapons fire and some forms of physical attacks. Equipping more than 1 wont yield additional effects, does not stack with other combat shields.
column2: 战斗护盾于 31 世纪末在索拉里斯七号投入使用，是一种可以安装在战斗机甲上的可移动装甲。它最初用于保护在索拉里斯竞技场作战的机甲战士。护盾主要用于防御武器火力和部分近身攻击，保护机甲免受伤害。安装超过 1 面护盾不会产生额外效果，也不会与其他战斗护盾叠加。

column2: 乍看之下，你可能会以为这只是普通的海盗破烂货，但它其实是一台大体完好的 SLDF 黄蜂，配备了原型手持武器系统。 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Fa Shih duplicates many of the features of the Inner Sphere Standard battle armor, including its jump capacity and most of the weaponry used. However the suit went against battle armor philosophy at the time by emphasizing defensive capabilities as much as offensive. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 法石战斗装甲沿用了许多内天体标准战斗装甲的设计，包括跳跃能力和大部分武器配置。不过，这套装甲在当时背离了战斗装甲理念：它对防御能力的重视不亚于攻击能力。 特性：鼓舞外观 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载任意单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You turn back to Darius shaking your head,  "That MechWarrior failed the Trial, as well as ended up in the infirmary.  I have no need of one such as them within our ranks."
column2: 你摇着头转向达利乌斯：“那名机甲战士没能通过试炼，还进了医务室。我不需要这样的人留在我们的队伍里。”

column1: You look at Darius, "Find out where my opponent is now and bring me a bondscord. We will do this the Clan way." Darius heads off to look for the fallen MechWarrior. Advance a day to get the results
column2: 你看向达利乌斯：“查清我的对手现在在哪里，把一根束缚绳带回来。我们按氏族的方式解决。” 达利乌斯离开去寻找那名落败的机甲战士。 推进一天以获取结果

column1: Based on Mad Dog's looted during Operation Bulldog has Skobel Mechworks released this design, Having to rely on Inner Sphere technologies forced them to Upgrade the Chassis by 10 Tons, despite sporting Clan Grade base Armor and Endo Steel and a permanently mounted Chin Turret. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 斯科贝尔机甲工坊根据缴获的疯狗机甲进行了这项设计，并在“斗牛犬行动”后将其发布。由于只能依赖内天体技术，他们不得不将底盘增重 10 吨，尽管它仍采用氏族级基础装甲、内骨骼，并永久安装了下巴炮塔。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: On second thought, Neg.
column2: 转念一想，不。

column1: The first BattleMech to utilize the advanced Void Signature System, while reports of 'invisible 'Mechs' had long been ignored as confusion for such Star League era stealth systems as the Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield, allowed the 'Stealth Raptor' to be used with deadly effect.
column2: 第一台采用先进虚空特征系统的战斗机甲。长期以来，关于“隐形机甲”的报告都被当作误将星盟时代的隐形系统（如零特征系统和变色偏振护盾）认作混乱现象而遭到忽视；这让“隐形迅猛龙”得以发挥致命效果。

column1: The Tercio is the Escorpión_Imperio's flagship BattleMech. The 185 ton behemoth is focused on massive firepower and supporting it with advanced technology to maximize its efficiency. Although constructed only in limited numbers, the Tercio has quickly gained a reputation of being able to overwhelm even the most reinforced of positions.
column2: Tercio 是 Escorpión_Imperio 的旗舰战斗机甲。这头重达 185 吨的巨兽以强大火力为核心，并以先进技术提升火力运用效率。虽然产量有限，Tercio 很快就因足以压垮最坚固阵地而声名远扬。

column1: The Thunderbird was created by Clan Nova Cat as a replacement Heavy Battle Armor. Its development started in the mid-3080s as a needed replacement for their touman's dwindling supply of frontline Elemental Battle Armor.
column2: 雷鸟由新星猫氏族制造，用于替代重型战斗装甲。它于 3080 年代中期开始研发，目的是填补氏族前线元素战斗装甲日益枯竭的缺口。

column1: The Purifier Adaptive battle armor is produced by Word of Blake, though the original data was stolen from ComStar. The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries
column2: 净化者自适应战斗装甲由圣言之书生产，最初的数据则是从 ComStar 窃取而来。它采用会变色的拟态装甲，堪称革命性设计。拟态装甲让净化者自适应装甲更难被锁定，静止时尤其如此。代价是它能携带的装甲量受到限制。

column1: The Imp II was developed as the next generation Command Mech by Clan Wolf and Clan Diamond Shark together. The result is a 140 ton, heavily armored 'Mech filled with EWS and lance coordination equipment, but is generally seen as a failure due to its lack of proper firepower for its cost.
column2: Imp II 由狼氏族与钻石鲨氏族共同研发，是新一代指挥机甲。它重达 140 吨，装甲厚重，配备 EWS 和长枪协调设备；但由于与成本相比火力不足，通常被视为失败之作。

column2: 莫尔-里奥汉

column1: In a bid to join the Arms Race of Inner Sphere OmniMech Designs, Hellespont reacted with an attempt to upgrade their most iconic salespiece, the UrbanMech. Dubbed the 'Mobile Turret', it does what every 'Urbie' has done before. Sadly, the increased cost and expertise required for maintenance, left it mostly unsold. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 为了加入内天体全能机甲的军备竞赛，赫勒斯庞特试图升级其最具代表性的畅销产品——城市机甲。它被冠以“移动炮塔”之名，做的仍是每台“小乌龟”过去一直在做的事。可惜维护所需的成本和专业能力都更高，结果几乎无人问津。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Thunderbird was created by Clan Nova Cat as a replacement Heavy Battle Armor. Its development started in the mid-3080s as a needed replacement for their touman's dwindling supply of frontline Elemental Battle Armor. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.952 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 雷鸟由新星猫氏族制造，用于替代重型战斗装甲。它于 3080 年代中期开始研发，目的是填补氏族前线元素战斗装甲日益枯竭的缺口。 特性：设计精良 部署费用倍率：0.952 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Thunderbird was created by Clan Nova Cat as a replacement Heavy Battle Armor. Its development started in the mid-3080s as a needed replacement for their touman's dwindling supply of frontline Elemental Battle Armor. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.955 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 雷鸟由新星猫氏族制造，用于替代重型战斗装甲。它于 3080 年代中期开始研发，目的是填补氏族前线元素战斗装甲日益枯竭的缺口。 特性：设计精良 部署费用倍率：0.955 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Vengeance Industries, attempting to get a foothold in the Market for OmniMechs, have redesigned the ancient Talos based on 'liberated' blueprints from Vandenberg MilTech. With a focus on easily maintainable parts, they have ensured that it can be repaired with spares from any Talos model. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Vengeance Industries 试图在全能机甲市场站稳脚跟，于是根据范登堡军工的“解放”蓝图重新设计了古老的 Talos。它采用易于维护的部件，因此可以使用任何 Talos 型号的备件进行维修。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, it's clear you made the right decision. A handful of void-suited passengers spin aimlessly away from a gaping hole in the hull, hoping against hope for rescue.\n\nYour tech staff manage to scoop up the survivors just before the transport explodes.
column2: 阿耳戈号抵达遇险信标源头时，你确信自己做出了正确决定。几名身穿真空服的乘客从舰体裂开的巨大破口旁无助地旋转漂浮，拼命等待救援。\n\n技术组在运输船爆炸前及时救起了幸存者。

column1: In an attempt to marry OmniTechnology to a Advanced Stealthed Land Air Mech have Shengli Arm's created the 'Berkut' based on recovered Shadowhawk LAM designs. Only being able to mount a limited amount of Slots was the Design still considered a success. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 胜利装甲试图将全能技术与先进隐形空天机甲结合，于是根据回收的影鹰 LAM 设计制造了“别尔库特”。虽然可安装的槽位有限，这一设计仍被认为是成功的。 特性：空天机甲 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang OmniMech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic armor, to blend into the night and hunt its victims. Quirk: AR20 WarFare Suite Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 阿斯旺以特兰土菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名。这台全能机甲采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀受害者。 特性：AR20 战争套件 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Cooperating with the Republic did Luthien Armor Works manage to create a upgraded version of the early Avatar OmniMech. Employing Advanced Technologies could it only be produced in limited numbers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 卢希恩装甲工坊与共和国合作，成功打造出早期阿凡达全能机甲的升级版。由于采用先进技术，该型号只能限量生产。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Odin Manufacturing built this for former KungsArmé soldiers after they got folded into the Ghost Bear Dominion. Those veterans wanted something that fit how they fought and the Dengier delivered. Ten official variants by 3155, which tells you how well the base chassis worked. Ghost Bear warriors eventually started using it too, which is about as good an endorsement as you can get.
column2: 奥丁制造为那些并入幽灵熊自治领的前昆斯军团士兵打造了这台机甲。老兵们需要一台符合自身战斗方式的机甲，而 Dengier 交出了满意答卷。3155 年前已确立十种官方变体，这足以说明基础底盘有多成功。后来连幽灵熊战士也开始使用它——这已经是最高级别的认可。

column1: Experimental Weapons Platform
column2: 实验武器平台

column1: All incoming damage reduced by 30%.
column2: 所有受到的伤害降低 30%。

column1: When StarCorps Industries wanted to move into the superheavy market, they created the Peacemaker. With a familiar exterior design they hoped to build on top of the Warhammer's reputation for being "just enough". However, the final product instead turned into a PPC focused 155 ton superheavy, which was not cheap nor as versatile as the Warhammer.
column2: 星际军团工业进军超重型市场时制造了和平缔造者。他们采用熟悉的外形设计，希望延续战锤“刚刚好”的声誉。然而最终产品却变成了一台以 PPC 为核心、重达 155 吨的超重型机甲，既不便宜，也没有战锤那么灵活。

column1: Requiring a more advanced and enduring Command Unit, designers have revisited the original Black Knight Specs. Taking cues from the Harjel system of Battle Armor, and advances from Clan Diamond Shark, this mech is outfitted with a specialized diagnostics and self repair system. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 由于需要更先进、更耐用的指挥单元，设计师重新审视了黑骑士的原始规格。他们借鉴战斗装甲的 Harjel 系统以及钻石鲨氏族的技术进展，为这台机甲配备了专用诊断与自我修复系统。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Gùn is a moderately fast light OmniMech which was designed by the Capellan Confederation as an Infantry Support 'Mech. Designed with 10 tons of pod space, the default configuration of the Gùn features a combination of anti-infantry and anti-vehicle energy weaponry. The 'Mech also features a Small Cockpit and an XL Gyro. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.92 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Gùn 是一台速度适中的轻型全能机甲，由联邦制设计为步兵支援机甲。它拥有 10 吨挂载舱空间，默认配置结合了反步兵与反载具能量武器。此外还配备小型驾驶舱和 XL 陀螺仪。 特性：短程瞄准增强 部署费用倍率：0.92 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: You rub your temples for a moment, "Go ahead and proceed with the repairs.  No use worrying about what I should have done to prevent this."\n\nDr Murad nods and instructs her team of astechs to begin repairing the damage to the Console.
column2: 你揉了揉太阳穴：“继续维修吧。现在再担心本该如何预防也没有意义。”\n\n穆拉德博士点点头，指示技术员们开始修复控制台的损伤。

column1: The 'Badb Catha' (Battle Crow) was named for old terran irish folklore after a Goddess of Death and Chaos, foreshadowing imminent Bloodshed and sowing confusion. Part of the Morrigan OmniMech program, alongside the Mhacha and Anand. Quirk: Morrigan C3i Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: “巴德·卡塔”（战鸦）以古老的特兰爱尔兰民间传说命名，源自一位象征死亡与混乱的女神，预示着即将到来的血腥与纷争。它属于莫里甘全能机甲计划，与 Mhacha 和 Anand 同属一个系列。 特性：莫里甘 C3i 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Startled by Darius' question, you take a minute before responding, "Sorry, I was doing the budget in my head.  Have Farah and her team begin the repairs on the console."\nDarius turns to the computer to type up the work order, "On to it, Commander."
column2: 达利乌斯的问题让你一愣。你停了一会儿才回答：“抱歉，我刚才在心算预算。让法拉和她的团队开始维修控制台。”\n达利乌斯转向电脑，开始输入工单：“收到，指挥官。”

column1: Based on the Word of Blake Raptor II BattleMech, similarly employing advanced Stealth technology and Electronics is the Raptor III even more capable of deep strike scout and intercept Missions, hardmounting a unique Advanced AMS System. Quirk: Integrated Adv. AMS Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Raptor III 基于圣言之书的 Raptor II 战斗机甲设计，同样采用先进隐形技术和电子设备，但更适合执行纵深侦察与拦截任务，并固定安装了独特的高级 AMS 系统。 特性：集成高级 AMS 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The first BattleMech to utilize the advanced Void Signature System, while reports of 'invisible 'Mechs' had long been ignored as confusion for such Star League era stealth systems as the Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield, allowed the 'Stealth Raptor' to be used with deadly effect. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 第一台采用先进虚空特征系统的战斗机甲。长期以来，关于“隐形机甲”的报告都被当作误将星盟时代的隐形系统（如零特征系统和变色偏振护盾）认作混乱现象而遭到忽视；这让“隐形迅猛龙”得以发挥致命效果。 特性：干扰增强 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Trinity is really three different battle armors, all initially constructed by the Capellan Confederation and therefore sharing the same base chassis. The Ying Long ("Shadow Dragon") uses the mimetic armor first created by Word of Blake for their Purifier, though how they acquired the technology is unknown. The Asterion and Theseus are functionally identical, but have different aesthetics.
column2: Trinity 实际上是三种不同的战斗装甲，最初都由联邦制制造，因此共用同一基础底盘。Ying Long（“影龙”）采用圣言之书为净化者开发的拟态装甲，但其技术来源至今不明。Asterion 和 Theseus 在功能上完全相同，只是外观不同。

column1: The Stone Giant is a 180 ton superheavy developed by Robinson Standard BattleWorks at their main research and development plant on Robinson III, loosely based on the Atlas. It's a very versatile chassis that exists in many variants with different configurations and roles. Although initially sold to Federated Suns only it soon reached new markets all over the Inner Sphere and even some larger Periphery states.
column2: 石巨人是罗宾逊标准战斗工坊在罗宾逊 III 号主要研发工厂制造的 180 吨超重型机甲，设计略微参考了擎天神。它是一款用途广泛的底盘，拥有多种配置和作战定位。最初只向联邦太阳销售，后来很快进入整个内天体，甚至一些较大的边缘邦国市场。

column1: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.
column2: Legionnaire 是联邦太阳对莱兰闪电战的回应，在圣言之书圣战期间开始生产。一支 Legionnaire 小队在新亚法隆第三次战役中发挥了重要作用：它们迅速攻击正在渡过泰晤士河的圣战派部队左翼，打破其攻势，最终迫使敌军撤离星球。Legionnaire 最高时速可达 118 公里，是优秀的快速侧翼机甲。

column1: The Umbriel is a 135 ton Superheavy 'Mech imagined as a continuation of the Celestial series. It carries the newly developed Superheavy version of the Void Signature System as well as the Blake developed massive Astral Hammer autocannon. It further sports the typical Blakist Omni Superheavy Mech equipment of a Buffered VDNI combined with a small cockpit and the Seraphim Suite networking system.
column2: Umbriel 是一台 135 吨超重型机甲，被视为天体系列的延续。它搭载新开发的超重型虚空特征系统，以及由布莱克开发的巨型星锤自动炮。此外还配备布莱克派超重型全能机甲的典型设备：缓冲式 VDNI、小型驾驶舱和 Seraphim 套件网络系统。

column1: The Templar III is a Dark Age era Assault Class OmniMech, first produced by General Motors for the Federated Suns. It was intended as a replacement for the original Templar, whose factory lines were destroyed during the Jihad. General Motors established a new production line on New Valencia for what was to become the next generation of the Templar with newer technologies.
column2: Templar III 是黑暗时代的强袭级全能机甲，最初由通用汽车为联邦太阳生产。它原本要替代最初的 Templar，后者的生产线在圣战期间被摧毁。通用汽车在新瓦伦西亚建立了新的生产线，制造这款采用更新技术的下一代 Templar。

column1: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor.
column2: Djinn 是已知最早的“恶魔系列”战斗装甲，由圣言之书为其人类主宰制造。Djinn 的设计目标就是让敌人心生恐惧。它纤细的外形显然是为人类主宰步兵量身打造的，因为他们的控制论强化弥补了“脆弱”的元素战士及其内天体对手操作战斗装甲所需的肌肉体格。

column1: The Serket is a Taurian Concordat produced 140 ton Omni QuadMech based on the older Scorpion. Its name is based on the old egyptian mythology from ancient times and was coined by a member of the design team born on Pharos, in the Alexandrian Covenant.
column2: Serket 是陶里安协约生产的 140 吨全能四足机甲，基于更老的 Scorpion 设计。它的名字源自古埃及神话，由一名出生于亚历山大公国法罗斯岛的设计团队成员命名。

column1: Obtaining a large number of mostly operational Battle Cobras in the aftermath of brutal conflict in the Devil's Bath during the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar selected the Battle Cobra as the focus of their efforts to reverse-engineer and develop their own OmniMech.
column2: 图卡伊德战役期间，魔鬼之浴发生了惨烈冲突。战后，ComStar 获得了大量基本仍能运作的 Battle Cobra，并将其作为逆向工程、开发自有全能机甲的重点项目。

column1: Clan Sea Fox built this a few years before Clan Wolf took Terra, named it after their old Diamond Shark identity. It sold well. The Federated Suns, Lyran Commonwealth, Capellans, Taurian Concordat, even the Magistracy bought their own versions. Hell's Horses ran a few variants too. Three hard-wired Medium Pulse Lasers in the left torso no matter what config you drop in, which tells you exactly how Sea Fox wanted this thing used. They built it to sell, and they built it right.
column2: 海狐氏族在狼氏族夺取 Terra 前几年制造了这台机甲，并以钻石鲨时期的旧身份为它命名。它卖得很好。联邦太阳、莱兰联邦、联邦制、陶里安协约，甚至摄政领都购买了自己的版本；地狱之马也运行着几种变体。无论采用哪种配置，左侧躯干都硬连着三门中型脉冲激光，这充分说明海狐希望它如何投入战斗。他们造它是为了销售，也确实把它造得很好。

column1: Fast Weapons Platform
column2: 快速武器平台

column1: At first you may think this is just typical Pirate Junk, but its a mostly intact SLDF Wasp with a Prototype Handheld Weapons System.
column2: 乍看之下，你可能会以为这只是普通的海盗破烂货，但它其实是一台大体完好的 SLDF 黄蜂，配备了原型手持武器系统。

column1: The Simian is a thirty-second century medium battle armor which was the brain child of Republic of the Sphere Paladin, Kara Rutherford. The design came about due in part to Paladin Rutherford's concern of the high cost of battle armor development. Her efforts to make a cost-effective design would give birth to the Simian, however, she would not live to see it enter production.
column2: Simian 是一款 32 世纪中型战斗装甲，由球体共和国圣骑士卡拉·卢瑟福构想。高昂的战斗装甲研发成本促使她开始这项设计。她希望打造一种高性价比型号，最终催生了 Simian；然而在它投入生产前，她便已去世。

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Phalanx 是由自由世界联盟的 Irian Technologies 设计并生产的战斗装甲。这一设计是自由世界联盟军事部队对 Kanazuchi 和 Gnome 等更大型、更重火力战斗装甲的回应。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.892 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 为了延续 Mad Cat 的传奇，Mk IV 采用了其“兄长”最强大的几种配置，同时加入了更容易寻找和更换的部件。海狐氏族希望这款机型能取得与前代相同的成功。 特性：执行器防护 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Logan-X, named such for some unknown reason, is an export superheavy 'Mech made by Quicsell and offloaded at a very cheap cost to the periphery states. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Logan-X 的命名原因已不可考。这是一台由 Quicsell 制造、以极低价格倾销给边缘邦国的出口型超重型机甲。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Bushranger is a Forestry and Surveyal 'Mech designed by the Star League to be deployed on planets still being 'tamed', the only design to receive unique reinforced structure and myomer more similar to Mech's far above its weight class is it not only sturdy, but able to carry large amounts of weight with ease. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Bushranger 是星盟为部署到仍待“驯服”的星球而设计的森林与测绘机甲。它是唯一采用独特强化结构和肌腱、使其性能更接近远高于自身重量级别机甲的设计；因此不仅坚固，还能轻松携带大量载荷。 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: To counter Capellan Amazons, the Cavalier II features the Grenadier II's Clan-spec stealth armor, enhanced jump mobility, and an anti-personnel weapon mount Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 为了对抗联邦制的亚马逊，Cavalier II 配备了 Grenadier II 的氏族规格隐形装甲、增强型跳跃机动性和反人员武器挂点。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You ponder her query for a few minutes before responding, "Leave the KF Console inactive for now and we will continue using normal travel for our next jump."\n\n<color=#FFA500> The KF Console is currently</color><color=#FF0000> INACTIVE.</color>
column2: 你思索了几分钟她的问题，然后回答道：“先让 KF 控制台保持停用，我们下一次跳跃继续使用普通航行。”\n\n<color=#FFA500> KF 控制台当前状态：</color><color=#FF0000>停用。</color>

column1: You rub your temples for a moment, "I just cannot see the logic in blindly replacing a possibly good part.  We've dealt with this random knocking noise so far.  At least it's not happening all the time."\n\nDr Murad nods and instructs her team of astechs to begin to reassemble the panels of the Console.  As they work, she turns back to you, "I'll let you know when whichver faulty component finally fails and takes the Console fully offline."
column2: 你揉了揉太阳穴：“我实在看不出盲目更换一个可能完好的部件有什么道理。到目前为止，我们已经应付了这阵随机出现的敲击声。至少它不是一直响个不停。”\n\n穆拉德博士点点头，指示技术员们开始重新装回控制台面板。工作期间，她转身对你说道：“等哪个故障部件最终彻底失效、让控制台完全下线时，我会通知你。”

column1: You shake your head at Yang. "I told you last time no more surprises in our supply crates. Chief, I can't afford to have half of your technicians in the MedBay with a bad case of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSHITS],S.H.I.T.S.]] Not like last time."\n\nYang visibly sags in his chair as you turn to your XO. "Darius, put those crates in the incinerator before anyone gets any bright ideas."
column2: 你朝杨摇摇头：“我上次就说过，补给箱里别再塞惊喜了。老杨，要是你一半的技术员都因为那种 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSHITS],S.H.I.T.S.]] 进了医务室，我可承担不起。上次就是这样。”\n\n你转向副官时，杨在椅子上明显泄了气。“达利乌斯，把那些箱子送进焚化炉，别让任何人再动什么歪脑筋。”

column1: A Manei Domini Omicron Poltergeist Operative. All Information is Classified Omicron-5 Clearance.\n\n
column2: 一名 Manei Domini 欧米茄级 Poltergeist 特工。所有信息均属机密，仅限欧米茄-5 级权限查看。\n\n

column1: Based on recovered Clan Crossbows and ancient SLDF experimental notes, RISC and Skobel Engineers managed to create a more modern Crossbow. Employing an experimental Extra-Light Gyro and Light Engine on an Endo-Steel chassis, they managed to upgrade both its mobility and firepower. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: RISC 和斯科贝尔工程师根据回收的氏族十字弩以及古老的 SLDF 实验记录，成功打造出更现代化的十字弩。他们在内骨骼底盘上采用实验性的超轻型陀螺仪和轻型引擎，提升了机动性与火力。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Named for an ancient God of the Forges, taming the Fires of Olympus, does this OmniMech design do its ancestor, the venerable Warhammer, proud. Built with a specialized Heat Dissipating Armor is it able to withstand incoming heat damage from its opponents. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台全能机甲以古代锻造之神、驾驭奥林匹斯火焰的赫淮斯托斯命名，没有辱没其祖先——久负盛名的战锤。它配备特制散热装甲，能够承受敌方造成的热损伤。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Sobek is a 170 ton superheavy, named after an ancient crocodile god in a long dead religion from Terra due the likeness of the 'Mech's head to an alligator. Produced within the Taurian Concordat by Vandenburg Mechanized Industries and sold to most anyone in the Periphery, it is quite a basic design for being a superheavy which makes it easy to maintain and repair.
column2: Sobek 是一台 170 吨超重型机甲，以 Terra 古老宗教中的鳄鱼神命名，因为它的机甲头部酷似短吻鳄。它由陶里安协约的范登堡机械工业生产，几乎销往所有边缘邦国。作为超重型机甲，它的设计相当基础，因此易于维护和维修。

column1: Twenty tons, Clan Omni, running at over 120 kph. Speed like that on a frame this light — it is impressive engineering, I will give Clan Burrock that. Shame about the Dark Caste connection. The pod space is tight at seven tons, so every config is making hard choices. Some do it well. Some less so. Whoever pilots one needs to keep moving and stay smart about range.
column2: 20 吨重的氏族全能机甲，速度超过 120 公里/小时。如此轻的底盘能有这种速度，确实是出色的工程，我得承认布洛克氏族做得不错。可惜它和黑暗氏族扯上了关系。挂载舱只有 7 吨，空间很紧，所以每种配置都必须做出取舍。有些配置做得很好，有些就差些。驾驶它的人必须持续移动，并时刻注意交战距离。

column1: The Praetorian is the ancestor to all other Superheavy 'Mechs. Created at the height of the first Starleague as a sign of power and prestige, it brought a totally new kind of mechanical beast to the battlefield. At 175 tons, it was so much larger than anything previously seen that it is claimed many foes fled as the mere sight of it.
column2: Praetorian 是所有其他超重型机甲的祖先。它在第一星盟鼎盛时期作为力量与威望的象征诞生，为战场带来一种全新的机械巨兽。它重达 175 吨，比此前任何机甲都大得多，据说许多敌人仅仅看到它就转身逃跑。

column1: The production Skinwalker removes the controversial triple-strength myomers of its prototype Ryoken III-XP. MechWarriors appreciated the speed boost, but the interface cockpit system made them more hesitant than other Clan MechWarriors to engage in physical combat. This rendered the myomers moot. Like its Stormcrow progenitor, the Skinwalker excels in a cavalry role, bringing heavy firepower to bear with speed and stunning accuracy
column2: 量产型 Skinwalker 移除了原型 Ryoken III-XP 上饱受争议的三重强化肌腱。机甲战士喜欢由此带来的速度提升，但接口驾驶舱系统让他们比其他氏族机甲战士更不愿进行近身战。这使强化肌腱失去了意义。和它的前身 Stormcrow 一样，Skinwalker 擅长骑兵定位，以高速和惊人精度倾泻重火力。

column1: In an attempt to marry OmniTechnology to a Advanced Stealthed Land Air Mech have Shengli Arm's created the 'Berkut' based on recovered Shadowhawk LAM designs. Only being able to mount a limited amount of Slots was the Design still considered a success.
column2: 胜利装甲试图将全能技术与先进隐形空天机甲结合，于是根据回收的影鹰 LAM 设计制造了“别尔库特”。虽然可安装的槽位有限，这一设计仍被认为是成功的。

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome.
column2: Phalanx 是由自由世界联盟的 Irian Technologies 设计并生产的战斗装甲。这一设计是自由世界联盟军事部队对 Kanazuchi 和 Gnome 等更大型、更重火力战斗装甲的回应。

column1: Flanker and All-Range Combat
column2: 侧翼突击与全距离作战

column1: Created by Clan Steel Viper as a means to carry their new Helical Railgun into battle. The 195 ton superheavy 'Mech is designed with stability in mind to counteract the huge recoil of its weapons.
column2: 钢蛇氏族制造它，是为了搭载新型螺旋轨道炮投入战场。这台 195 吨超重型机甲以稳定性为设计重点，用来抵消武器产生的巨大后坐力。

column1: Superheavy Missile Boat
column2: 超重型导弹艇

column1: Based on Mad Dog's looted during Operation Bulldog has Skobel Mechworks released this design, Having to rely on Inner Sphere technologies forced them to Upgrade the Chassis by 10 Tons, despite sporting Clan Grade base Armor and Endo Steel and a permanently mounted Chin Turret.
column2: 斯科贝尔机甲工坊根据缴获的疯狗机甲进行了这项设计，并在“斗牛犬行动”后将其发布。由于只能依赖内天体技术，他们不得不将底盘增重 10 吨，尽管它仍采用氏族级基础装甲、内骨骼，并永久安装了下巴炮塔。

column1: The Fa Shih duplicates many of the features of the Inner Sphere Standard battle armor, including its jump capacity and most of the weaponry used. However the suit went against battle armor philosophy at the time by emphasizing defensive capabilities as much as offensive.
column2: 法石战斗装甲沿用了许多内天体标准战斗装甲的设计，包括跳跃能力和大部分武器配置。不过，这套装甲在当时背离了战斗装甲理念：它对防御能力的重视不亚于攻击能力。

column1: You look at Sumire, "Find a way to turn that damned console off!" Sumire quickly flicks a couple switches and the console dims and shuts down, "Commander, the Console is set to shutdown. The jump clock shows our ride will be jumping us out in 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. As your vision returns post jump, Darius grabs your attention, "Commander, the astechs on the jumpship have traced the power flux to the Argo. The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." Ignoring him for the moment, you look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the Fu..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we have misjumped and are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system. All stations are reporting operational as well, so we did not suffer any damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]].
column2: 你看向苏米尔：“想办法把那该死的控制台关掉！” 苏米尔迅速拨动几个开关，控制台逐渐变暗并关闭：“指挥官，控制台已设为关机。跳跃计时器显示，飞船将在 3……2……1……后把我们弹出……”片刻后，跳跃船的 KF 驱动启动，穿越空间时那阵令人恶心的眩晕感席卷全身。 你在跳跃后逐渐恢复视线，达利乌斯引起了你的注意：“指挥官，跳跃船上的技术员追踪到能量波动来自阿耳戈号。跳跃船的舰长怒不可遏，等他们完成全船诊断和损伤评估后，就会向雇佣兵评议委员会和商业跳跃船运输管理局提交报告。” 你暂时不理会他，望向舷窗外。眼前是一个与你预期完全不同的星系：“这他妈是……” 苏米尔打断了你的怒骂：“指挥官，我们似乎遭遇了跳跃偏差，现在位于 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系。所有空间站都报告运行正常，因此我们没有因[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],跳跃偏差]]受到任何损伤。”

column1: You look at Sumire, "I guess we prepare to jump...!" The jump clock slowly counts down... 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. As your vision returns post jump, Darius grabs your attention, "Commander, the astechs on the jumpship have traced the power flux to the Argo. The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." Ignoring him for the moment, you look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the Fu..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we have misjumped and are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system. All stations are reporting operational as well, so we did not suffer any damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]].
column2: 你看向苏米尔：“看来我们该准备跳跃了……！” 跳跃计时器缓缓倒数……3……2……1……片刻后，跳跃船的 KF 驱动启动，穿越空间时那阵令人恶心的眩晕感席卷全身。 你在跳跃后逐渐恢复视线，达利乌斯引起了你的注意：“指挥官，跳跃船上的技术员追踪到能量波动来自阿耳戈号。跳跃船的舰长怒不可遏，等他们完成全船诊断和损伤评估后，就会向雇佣兵评议委员会和商业跳跃船运输管理局提交报告。” 你暂时不理会他，望向舷窗外。眼前是一个与你预期完全不同的星系：“这他妈是……” 苏米尔打断了你的话：“指挥官，我们似乎遭遇了跳跃偏差，现在位于 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系。所有空间站都报告运行正常，因此我们没有因[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],跳跃偏差]]受到任何损伤。”

column1: Sitting in your command chair, you can feel the even rhythm coming from the jumpships Kearny-Fuchida drive that the Argo is docked to as it charges in preparation for jump. That rhythm soon takes on an erractic pulse, with vibrations and shudders groaning throughout the Argo, You look over to Darius, "STATUS REPORT!" Darius, busy at the terminal calls out, "Commander, it appears something is malfunctioning on the jumpship. Their Captain reports engineering is working on it, but they do not know the reason or source at this time!" Sumire gets your attention, "Commander, it appears the Kerby-Fucheatah Console is sending data to the jumpship." You look over to her, "What? I thought it only sent data the one time to the jumpship. You mean to tell me it is doing something more than that?" Sumire punches buttons on the console, "I believe so, Commander." You jump out of your command chair and rush over to the console. The data displayed makes no real sense to you. You look at Sumire, "Well, you're the navigator, how do we stop this?" Sumire's hands run over the keyboard, pressing various buttons before she looks at you, "I do not think we can stop this, Commander. When I try to deactivate the console, it displays a timer for shutdown, but the next jump will have occured by the time it actually shuts off. What should we do Commander?"
column2: 你坐在指挥椅上，感受着停靠阿耳戈号的跳跃船正在充能准备跳跃，凯尔尼-富奇达驱动器传来均匀的节奏。 节奏很快变成不规则的脉冲，振动和震颤在阿耳戈号各处轰鸣。你转向达利乌斯：“汇报情况！” 达利乌斯忙着操作终端，大声回答：“指挥官，跳跃船似乎出了故障。他们的舰长说工程组正在处理，但目前还不知道原因或故障源！” 苏米尔引起你的注意：“指挥官，凯尔比-富切塔控制台正在向跳跃船发送数据。” 你转头看她：“什么？我以为它只向跳跃船发送过一次数据。你的意思是它还在做别的事？” 苏米尔在控制台上快速按下几个按钮：“我认为是的，指挥官。” 你从指挥椅上跳起来，冲向控制台。屏幕上的数据对你毫无意义。你看向苏米尔：“你是领航员，想办法阻止它。” 苏米尔的手指在键盘上飞快移动，按下各种按钮后抬起头：“我不认为我们能阻止它，指挥官。我尝试停用控制台时，它显示了关机计时器，但等它真正关闭时，下一次跳跃已经完成了。我们该怎么办，指挥官？”

column1: You frown, "So get the parts from storage and replace them." Farah grabs her noteputer and scans the inventory. A few moments later she finds what she is looking for, "Excellent!! We're in luck Commander. We do have all the parts needed to repair the Console. It shouldn't take the Techs and myself more than a few days to get everything up and running." You smile broadly, "Excellent news Farah! Go ahead and schedule the work order." The KF Console is under repairsSTATUS: OFFLINE.
column2: 你皱起眉头：“那就从仓库取出零件换上。” 法拉拿起记事终端，扫描库存。片刻后，她找到了需要的东西：“太好了！我们走运，指挥官。修复控制台所需的零件全都有。技术组和我最多花几天就能让它重新运转。” 你露出笑容：“这是个好消息，法拉！去安排工单吧。” KF 控制台正在维修状态：离线。

column1: You look at Sumire, "I guess we prepare to jump...!" The jump clock slowly counts down... 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. "Report," you yell as your vision returns post jump and you turn to see the Console smoking. Sumire and an astech are dousing it with an extinguisher. After the smoke clears, Sumire examines the Console, "Commander, the Console is offline and some of the components have been destroyed. Engineering reports major damage to the engine and structure of the Argo." Darius moves over to the sensor station, "Commander, we appear to be in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system now and the Captain of the jumpship has just sent a message. Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline. Travel times are increased until repairs can be made to the console and engines.

column1: With a noticeable lack of OmniMechs designed in the Federated Suns, Field Marshal Duke George Hasek went over the heads of the Department of the Quartermaster and commissioned Kallon Industries to design an assault OmniMech and backed the project with his own financial resources. The resulting 'Mech is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 联邦太阳几乎没有自行设计的全能机甲。于是，陆军元帅乔治·哈塞克公爵越过军需部门，委托卡隆工业设计一台强袭全能机甲，并用自己的资金支持项目。最终诞生的机甲足以在现代战场上令人闻风丧胆。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: You ponder her query for a few minutes before responding, Good work, Farah. Set the KF Console to ACTIVE and we will use a Pirate Point for our next jump."\n\n The KF Console is now online. STATUS: ACTIVE."
column2: 你思索了几分钟她的问题，然后回答道：“干得好，法拉。把 KF 控制台设为 启用，我们下一次跳跃就使用海盗跳跃点。”\n\n KF 控制台已上线。状态：启用。

column1: You turn to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Are you sure you want to do this? It sounds VERY risky and dangerous, possibly even fatal." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks you in the eye, full of confidence, "Commander, I know I can do this. My gambling habits and put me here, and there is no way I can earn the C-Bills to pay them off. I will win this and erase my debt once and for all." "Very well then." You spin around to address Front Man, "Okay, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] agrees to participate in your 'game'. Where are we headed to?" Front Man smiles, "My dear Commander, 'We' are not going anywhere, only [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is leaving for the arena. The dropship Moirai is approaching even as we speak. Please allow it to dock with the Argo. Only [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is allowed through the airlock onto the Moirai and anyone else caught trying to get on board will be dealt with severely." "And how will we know whether [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] passes your challenge?" you ask. "[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] will return to you when the games are finished. Along with the applicable bonuses mentioned before," states Front Man at which point the holocom goes dark. With a nod of {SCN_MW.DET} head, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] heads off down the corridor to board the Moirai. You sincerely hope you get to see {SCN_MW.DET} alive and well soon.
column2: 你转向 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]：“你确定要这么做吗？听起来风险极高，甚至可能送命。” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 自信地直视你的双眼：“指挥官，我知道自己能做到。我的赌博习惯把我逼到了这一步，而我根本赚不到足够的 C-Bills 还债。我会赢下这场比赛，一劳永逸地清偿债务。” “好吧。”你转身面对中间人：“好，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 同意参加你的游戏。我们要去哪儿？” 中间人笑了：“亲爱的指挥官，我们哪儿也不去，只有 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 要去竞技场。运输船莫伊莱正在接近。请让它与阿耳戈号对接。只有 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 可以通过气闸登上莫伊莱，任何试图跟上的人都会受到严厉处置。” “那我们怎么知道 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 是否通过了你的挑战？”你问。 “比赛结束后，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 会回到你身边。还有之前提到的相应奖励。”中间人说完，全息通讯便熄灭了。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 点了点 {SCN_MW.DET} 的头，沿着走廊登上莫伊莱。你由衷希望很快能看到 {SCN_MW.DET} 平安归来。

column1: The Aries is a Star Adder assault OmniMech produced on Arcadia, with a possible secondary facility near their invasion corridor. It merges the banned Osteon's design with elements from the Blood Asp, offering 56 tons of pod space - matching the Tomahawk II. Though lacking Ferro-Lamelor armor, its durability and adaptability make it a serious threat. Reports indicate up to 16 variants, each capable of engaging at any range with ballistic, missile, and energy loadouts. Some variants show exceptional endurance and heat resistance, staying active under conditions that would disable most 'Mechs. The Aries should be considered a top-tier battlefield threat.
column2: Aries 是一台由星蝰氏族制造、在阿卡迪亚生产的强袭全能机甲，氏族入侵走廊附近可能还有一座备用工厂。它将被禁用的 Osteon 设计与血斑蛇的部件结合，提供 56 吨挂载舱空间，与 Tomahawk II 相当。虽然没有 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲，但它的耐久性和适应能力使其成为严重威胁。报告显示它有多达 16 种变体，每种都能以弹道、导弹和能量配置应对任何距离的交战。有些变体拥有出色的续航与耐热能力，在足以让大多数机甲瘫痪的环境中仍能持续作战。Aries 应被视为顶级战场威胁。

column1: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Centurion 全能机甲源于 Corean Enterprises 扩大市场份额的愿望。它主要在新亚法隆的 Corean Enterprises 工厂生产，重 50 吨，配备 Magna 250 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 86 公里/小时，并装有 9.5 吨标准装甲。十个固定式双重散热器为 Centurion 提供了 24 吨挂载舱空间，几乎占机甲总重量的一半；它的常见变体也延续了几个世纪以来原始 Centurion 战斗机甲的不同配置。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Preta (which means ghost in Hindi) is the second-lightest in the Word of Blake's new Celestial series of OmniMechs, which are primarily piloted by Manei Domini. As with the other Celestials, the Preta was designed by Doctor Devon Cortland. Like the others, this 'Mech is full of brand new, 3069-era technology, featuring a C3i Computer and a small cockpit. It is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and uses a light fusion engine for power. For protection, the Preta uses nine tons of standard armor. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Preta（印地语意为“鬼魂”）是圣言之书新型天体系列全能机甲中第二轻的型号，主要由人类主宰驾驶。和其他天体机甲一样，Preta 由德文·科特兰博士设计，充满 3069 年代的全新技术，配备 C3i 计算机和小型驾驶舱。它采用轻型内骨骼底盘，并以轻型聚变引擎提供动力。为加强防护，Preta 搭载 9 吨标准装甲。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: You and Darius head over to the Infirmary, where you are stopped by a nurse outside the entrance, "May I assist you?," the nurse asks. Darius steps forward, "My Commander was one of the combatants in that duel, and wished to speak with the opponent he faced." The nurse types in some information into the computer, "I regret to inform you, but that pilot succumbed to their injuries," You address the nurse, "Any chance I can pay my respects to the deceased?" The nurse points at the palm scanner, "Place your hand there to sign in, then go through the doors to the 3rd room on the left." You follow the directions given and arrive with Darius at the room. Behind a windowed wall is the body of your opponent, covered by a sheet. You stare through the window at the body of your former opponent, "We mourn your passing, MechWarrior. You fought bravely." You and Darius then exit the building to head back to the Argo
column2: 你和达利乌斯前往医务室，却在门外被一名护士拦下：“需要我帮忙吗？” 达利乌斯上前说道：“我的指挥官是那场决斗的参战者之一，想和自己的对手谈谈。” 护士在电脑中输入信息：“很遗憾，那名飞行员伤重不治。” 你对护士说：“我能去向死者致意吗？” 护士指向掌纹扫描器：“把手放上去登记，然后穿过门，左手边第三个房间。” 你按她的指示行动，和达利乌斯来到房间。隔着玻璃墙，你看到对手的尸体被白布盖着。你凝视着昔日对手的遗体：“我们为你的离去哀悼，机甲战士。你战斗得很勇敢。” 你和达利乌斯离开建筑，返回阿耳戈号。

column1: The Fujin, for Shinto 'Wind God', is comparably slow for a VTOL but carries a extremely heavy and advanced Weapons Payload, most notable a Clan-Grade Improved Heavy Medium Laser in all versions. This loadout's stealth capabilities are somewhat reduced until after it delivers its array of pylon-mounted weapons. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Vehicle Adv. Stealth Structure: Vehicle Composite Values A S Front 110 15 Left 100 15 Right 100 15 Rear 75 15 Total 400 75 Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Omni Vehicle
column2: Fujin 在神道教中意为“风神”。作为一台垂直起降载具，它的速度相对较慢，却携带极其沉重且先进的武器载荷，所有版本最引人注目的是一门氏族级改进型重型中型激光。它在释放挂载于翼架上的武器前，隐形能力会有所降低。 生物群系限制：无法部署于月面生物群系。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米。 装甲：载具高级隐形 结构：载具复合结构 数值 A S 正面 110 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 75 15 总计 400 75 特性：防空瞄准 全能载具

column1: The Malak is the lightest in the Word of Blake's Celestial series of OmniMechs designed for the Manei Domini. The Malak, Arabic for angel, features a dazzling array of new construction materials in an attempt to free up as much weight as possible in a fast and reliable package. The 'Mech is protected with six tons of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor which weighs less than standard armor. To free up even more space, the 'Mech mounts an XL Gyro, and a small cockpit in addition to its Endo Steel frame. A C3i Computer allows it to sync with other Manei Domini so equipped. Nine and a half tons are left for modular equipment. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Malak 是圣言之书为人类主宰设计的天体系列全能机甲中最轻的一台。Malak 在阿拉伯语中意为“天使”，采用大量新型建造材料，尽可能减轻重量，同时保持高速与可靠性。它以 6 吨轻型 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲提供防护，重量低于标准装甲。为进一步腾出空间，它在内骨骼框架之外还安装了 XL 陀螺仪和小型驾驶舱。C3i 计算机可以让它与其他配备同类设备的人类主宰同步。剩余 9.5 吨用于模块化设备。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：0.94 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Kobold is a battle armor design that was collaborated on by the Free Rasalhague Republic, ComStar, and the second Star League. Originaly a project for a battlesuit that could mimic the capabilities of the Draconis' Kage, later the concept of shifted somewhat to a light armor that can still hold its own in battle. The Kobold can only jump up to ninety meters at a time, but it does boast enough armor to stop a Medium Laser. This armor is of the basic stealth variety, making it more difficult to target far away.
column2: Kobold 是自由拉萨哈格共和国、ComStar 与第二星盟合作设计的战斗装甲。它最初是模仿德拉科尼斯影武者能力的战斗服项目，后来概念有所转变，成为一套仍能在战场上自立的轻型装甲。Kobold 一次最多只能跳跃 90 米，但装甲厚度足以抵挡中型激光。它采用基础隐形装甲，因此远距离下更难被锁定。

column1: Designed on Mars during the Early Clanbuster program in an attempt to incorporate OmniMech Technology into a well understood Design. Named for Terran Mythology for a god of verastility and the ability to assume many form. Constantly being upgraded with the latest technologies first by Comstar, then Word of Blake and lastly by Republic Engineers. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台机甲在早期“破族者”计划期间于火星设计，目标是把全能机甲技术融入一套成熟可靠的设计。它以特兰神话中一位能驾驭多种形态、象征多才多艺的神祇命名。它不断升级最新技术，先后由 ComStar、圣言之书，最后由共和国工程师进行改进。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Debuting in 3069, the Celestial series of OmniMechs are engineered to be used by the elite Word of Blake Manei Domini troops. The Archangel is the largest of these. Designed to be an anchor for Word formations, the 'Mech is known as a zombie because of its ability to take extreme amounts of damage and continue operating. The Archangel features a compact fusion engine, compact gyro, a small cockpit, and nineteen and a half tons of standard armor, which frees up a large amount of internal space, while an Endo Steel frame opens up free tonnage, making heavier components possible. A C3i Computer helps direct and coordinate fire. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 天体系列全能机甲于 3069 年首次亮相，专为圣言之书的人类主宰精英部队打造。Archangel 是其中最大的一台。它被设计为圣言之书编队的核心，以能够承受极端伤害并继续作战而被称为“僵尸”。Archangel 配备紧凑型聚变引擎、紧凑型陀螺仪、小型驾驶舱和 19.5 吨标准装甲，从而腾出大量内部空间；内骨骼框架又进一步释放了可用吨位，让它能够安装更重的部件。C3i 计算机帮助它指挥并协调火力。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Assassin II is the result of a Federated Suns specification calling for a 'quick strike harasser unit'. The Maltex Corporation proposed a major redesign of their older Assassin chassis, the resulting BattleMech exceeded all expectations and has started to see use as a counter to the stealth technology employed by the Capellan Confederation. Quirk: Integrated TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Assassin II 源于联邦太阳提出的“快速突袭骚扰单位”需求。Maltex Corporation 对老款 Assassin 底盘进行了大幅重新设计，成品机甲超出所有预期，如今已开始用于对抗联邦制采用的隐形技术。 特性：集成 TSM 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Baras Main Battle Tank of the Serpentus OmniTank Series. Relying not only on Stealth Systems but also massive Armor and a Prototype Advanced AMS plus Ewar Suite can it hold any Line all by itself. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Vehicle Adv. Stealth Structure: Structure Values A S Front 330 40 Left 330 40 Right 330 40 Rear 280 40 Turret 330 40 Total 1600 200 Quirk: Improved Anti-Missile Systems Omni Vehicle
column2: Serpentus 全能坦克系列的 Baras 主战坦克。它不仅依靠隐形系统，还凭借厚重装甲、原型高级 AMS 和电子战套件，足以独自守住整条战线。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：载具高级隐形 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 330 40 左侧 330 40 右侧 330 40 后方 280 40 炮塔 330 40 总计 1600 200 特性：改进型反导系统 全能载具

column1: The Incubus II only has two torso-mounted ER Medium Pulse Lasers for offensive armament. A Laser AMS system was installed in the head to protect the pilot from missile attacks. The installation of more jump jets and the Partial Wing has reduced the available space for weaponry, but the Hell's Horses found an answer for that problem: They created several hand-held weapons systems that add additional firepower and provide commanders and pilots with some of the tactical flexibility of an OmniMech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Incubus II 的攻击武器只有安装在躯干上的两门 ER 中型脉冲激光。头部安装了激光 AMS 系统，用于保护驾驶员免受导弹攻击。更多跳跃喷口和部分机翼占用了武器空间，但地狱之马找到了应对办法：他们制造了多种手持武器系统，既能增加火力，也能让指挥官和驾驶员拥有全能机甲的战术灵活性。 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The newest of the Word of Blake's Demon Series of battle armor is the Nephilim. Named for a group of half-angels from the bible who dwelt with mortals, the name may hint at the unit's intended close relationship with the Celestial series. Like the Celestial series, the Nephilim employs modular and/or detachable weapon mounts to give it a flexibility few other Demon series suits possess. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.904 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 圣言之书恶魔系列最新的战斗装甲是 Nephilim。它以圣经中与凡人共同生活的半天使族群命名，这个名字或许暗示了它与天体系列之间的紧密联系。和天体系列一样，Nephilim 采用模块化及可拆卸武器挂点，灵活性远超恶魔系列的其他装甲。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：0.904 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried.
column2: 它基于标准净化者战斗装甲，主要区别是移除了拟态装甲，换成与元素战士装甲相同的氏族标准装甲。Purifier Terra 使用模块化武器挂点，提供多种武器选择。联军曾遭遇装备氏族级 ER 小型激光、小型脉冲激光和 AP 高斯步枪的变体，另一些变体使用中型无后坐力步枪。除此之外，只要能装进 400 千克模块化武器挂点的设备都可以携带。

Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Kobold 是自由拉萨哈格共和国、ComStar 与第二星盟合作设计的战斗装甲。它最初是模仿德拉科尼斯影武者能力的战斗服项目，后来概念有所转变，成为一套仍能在战场上自立的轻型装甲。Kobold 一次最多只能跳跃 90 米，但装甲厚度足以抵挡中型激光。它采用基础隐形装甲，因此远距离下更难被锁定。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：0.886 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You address Front Man, "Whilst we appreciate your intentions to keep things civil, it does not change the fact that you hacked into our comms system instead of contacting us through normal channels. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] will remain in my employ and you can sort it out at the end of their contract." Front Man looks at you with displeasure, "This is a most unfortunate turn of events, Commander. Know this, we will get our money from [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], with interest, and your company may end up as collateral damage as well." A scowl crosses your face, "Is that a threat?" Front Man, smiles at you, "Oh no, Commander. No threat at all. That is a promise." The image on the holocom winks out. Darius looks concerned, "Commander, is it wise to have a powerful organisation possibly looking for us?" "Darius," you state calmly, "If they were truly a threat, they would not have needed to go through us to get to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] now would they?" Even then, you still wonder if you have heard the last from Front Man
column2: 你对中间人说：“我们很感激你想维持和平，但这改变不了你入侵我们通讯系统、而不是通过正常渠道联系我们的事实。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 仍会为我效力，等合同结束后你们再解决这件事。” 中间人不悦地看着你：“这是个非常不幸的转折，指挥官。记住，我们会连本带利从 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 身上拿回钱，你的公司也可能成为附带损失。” 你皱起眉头：“这是威胁吗？” 中间人笑了笑：“不，指挥官。完全不是威胁。这是承诺。” 全息通讯画面随即熄灭。 达利乌斯忧心忡忡：“指挥官，让一个强大组织盯上我们，明智吗？” “达利乌斯，”你平静地说，“如果他们真想对付我们，就不需要先通过我们接触 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，对吧？” 即便如此，你仍不禁怀疑，自己是否已经听到了中间人的最后一句话。

column1: The Sheng Long is a Quad type Heavy Class Battle Armor produced for both the Capellan Confederation and its close-allies in the Magistracy of Canopus. Designed with speed and firepower in mind, the Sheng Long employs its modular turret and stealth to out maneuver and assist in ambushing of enemy combat units. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: Sheng Long 是一款四足重型战斗装甲，由联邦制为自己及其在坎诺普斯摄政领的亲密盟友生产。它以速度和火力为设计重点，采用模块化炮塔和隐形能力，能够机动压制敌方战斗单位并协助伏击。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.892 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The second of the Demon Series of battle armor to be spotted, the Tengu also appears to feature the most experimentation. Named after Japanese demons, the Tengu is unique for boasting both an enhanced ground speed and jump jets allowing it to leap sixty meters at a time in what some observers call "an overworked motive system arrangement." Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.898 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Tengu 是目前发现的第二种恶魔系列战斗装甲，也似乎是实验性最强的一种。它以日本传说中的妖怪命名，拥有增强型地面速度和跳跃喷口，一次可跳跃 60 米；有些观察者称这种配置为“过度强化的动力系统”。 特性：凶悍 部署费用倍率：0.898 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Kobold is a battle armor design that was collaborated on by the Free Rasalhague Republic, ComStar, and the second Star League. Originaly a project for a battlesuit that could mimic the capabilities of the Draconis' Kage, later the concept of shifted somewhat to a light armor that can still hold its own in battle. The Kobold can only jump up to ninety meters at a time, but it does boast enough armor to stop a Medium Laser. This armor is of the basic stealth variety, making it more difficult to target far away. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Kobold 是自由拉萨哈格共和国、ComStar 与第二星盟合作设计的战斗装甲。它最初是模仿德拉科尼斯影武者能力的战斗服项目，后来概念有所转变，成为一套仍能在战场上自立的轻型装甲。Kobold 一次最多只能跳跃 90 米，但装甲厚度足以抵挡中型激光。它采用基础隐形装甲，因此远距离下更难被锁定。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：0.889 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You look at Sumire, "I guess we prepare to jump...!" The jump clock slowly counts down... 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. As your vision returns post jump, Darius grabs your attention, "Commander, the astechs on the jumpship have traced the power flux to the Argo. The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." Ignoring him for the moment, you look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the Fu..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we have misjumped and are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system. All stations are reporting operational as well, so we did not suffer any damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]].
column2: 你看向苏米尔：“看来我们该准备跳跃了……！” 跳跃计时器缓缓倒数……3……2……1……片刻后，跳跃船的 KF 驱动启动，穿越空间时那阵令人恶心的眩晕感席卷全身。 你在跳跃后逐渐恢复视线，达利乌斯引起了你的注意：“指挥官，跳跃船上的技术员追踪到能量波动来自阿耳戈号。跳跃船的舰长怒不可遏，等他们完成全船诊断和损伤评估后，就会向雇佣兵评议委员会和商业跳跃船运输管理局提交报告。” 你暂时不理会他，望向舷窗外。眼前是一个与你预期完全不同的星系：“这他妈是……” 苏米尔打断了你的话：“指挥官，我们似乎遭遇了跳跃偏差，现在位于 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系。所有空间站都报告运行正常，因此我们没有因[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],跳跃偏差]]受到任何损伤。”

column1: The Grenadier is a battle armor design created by the Hahm-Heinz Design Bureau. The firm has long had a relationship with General Motors' secondary plants on Talcott and Salem, so when the NAIS first started creating battle armor, Hahm-Heinz had access to prototypes that they could work from. The armor is where the Grenadier is lacking, having only enough to stop an Inner Sphere Large Pulse Laser, the same amount as the venerable Inner Sphere Standard. This armor, however, is standard stealth armor, so the Grenadier is a bit more difficult to target.
column2: Grenadier 是由 Hahm-Heinz 设计局制造的战斗装甲。该公司长期与塔尔科特和塞勒姆的通用汽车附属工厂合作，因此 NAIS 开始研发战斗装甲时，Hahm-Heinz 已经拥有可供参考的原型。Grenadier 的短板在于装甲，防护力仅足以抵挡内天体大型脉冲激光，与久经考验的内天体标准战斗装甲相同。不过它使用标准隐形装甲，因此比普通战斗装甲更难被锁定。

column1: The Menace is one of the heavier Clan Superheavy OmniMechs, weighing in at 185 tons. Based on an Endo Steel chassis with a 350 XL engine, the chassis is not particularly fast or agile, but it makes up for it with its general offensive package. All configurations of the Menace are heavily focused on offensive firepower at range, often used as a long range option when firepower matters more than survival. To ensure it has enough cooling it uses the volataile Prototype heat sinks, meaning any internal critical hits can turn deadly, but an acceptable risk considering its large offensive arsenal.
column2: Menace 是较重的氏族超重型全能机甲之一，重达 185 吨。它采用内骨骼底盘和 350 XL 引擎，速度与灵活性并不突出，但通用攻击配置弥补了这一点。Menace 的所有配置都高度侧重远距离火力，往往在火力比生存更重要时作为远程选项使用。为保证散热，它采用不稳定的原型散热器，这意味着内部暴击可能引发致命后果；考虑到它庞大的攻击武库，这仍是可以接受的风险。

column1: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. The Leonidas suit is highly configurable, capable of being reconfigured for various battlefield missions including providing positional information, calling in artillery strikes, waging counterinsurgency warfare and conducting ambushes; the various roles are made possible through the different weapons and equipment loadouts available via the Modular Weapon Mount.
column2: Leonidas 战斗装甲由埃特纳铸造厂制造，原本用于弥补东方公国武装部队的能力缺口；这一缺口源于老式 Achileus 隐形装甲稀缺。Leonidas 高度可配置，能够针对不同战场任务重新调整，包括提供阵地信息、呼叫炮击、执行反叛乱行动和实施伏击。模块化武器挂点提供了多种武器与设备配置，使这些任务成为可能。

column1: The brainchild of Dr. Stephen Vance, Tortoise II Battle Armor was an assault-class quad battle armor developed by the Republic of the Sphere. It was a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies utilized by the Republic which was costly for StarCorps Industries of Terra to develop due to the unique design features Dr. Vance incorporated into it. Dr. Vance utilized wheels instead of rear legs to help the design carry its twin weapons modules onto the battlefield. Nicknamed the \"Wheelbarrow\", the original Tortoise prototype was a money pit. After a redesign and technology purchase from Arc-Royal MechWorks, the new Tortoise II proved to be successful despite its critics.
column2: Tortoise II 战斗装甲由斯蒂芬·万斯博士构想，是球体共和国研发的强袭级四足战斗装甲。它融合共和国采用的内天体与氏族技术；由于万斯博士加入了独特设计特征，开发成本让 Terra 的星际军团工业不堪重负。万斯博士用轮子取代后腿，让它能够将两组武器模块运上战场。最初的 Tortoise 原型被戏称为“独轮车”，是个吞金黑洞。重新设计并从 Arc-Royal 机甲工坊购入技术后，新型 Tortoise II 尽管饱受质疑，最终仍获得成功。

column1: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps.
column2: 治安官镇压服由幽灵熊氏族推出，旨在帮助幽灵熊自治领维持内天体出生公民的秩序。幽灵熊守望队最初研发它，是为了对付一个名为 Motstånd 的拉萨哈格恐怖组织。装甲的武器和设备选项丰富，使守望队能够处理恐怖分子，同时避免动用全面军事化的警察力量伤害平民。守望队第一次使用该装甲时处理不当。后来将它出售给民用警察及其他组织，让守望队得以发展更少军事化的战术。如今它已经传播到其他氏族，以及龙辰联邦的内务安全部队和民事指导队等准军事组织。

column1: Initially under development by Clan Ghost Bear as directed by Galaxy Commander Ramiel "Warbear" Bekker and named for the Grecian nymph in the Terran constellation of Ursa Major, the Callisto was designed to correct a tactical deficiency in the Rasalhague Dominion's infantry. The development resulted in two near identical versions of the Battle Armor, with only serial numbers and machining details being the only major differentiation between the two. The Callisto is based on the time tested Elemental Battle Suit making it a both recognizable, if a bit peculiar sight, and easy for warriors to switch to should the need arise. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Callisto 最初由幽灵熊氏族在银河指挥官拉米尔“战熊”·贝克尔的指示下研发，并以 Terra 大熊座中的希腊宁芙命名，旨在弥补拉萨哈格自治领步兵的战术缺陷。研发结果是两种几乎完全相同的战斗装甲，主要差别只有序列号和加工细节。Callisto 以久经考验的元素战斗服为基础，外观既熟悉又略显古怪；需要时，战士也能轻松转用。 特性：直觉控制 部署费用倍率：0.93 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Produced on Shitara for The Republic of the Sphere, the Thunderbird II battle armor is an upgrade of the Thunderbird battle armor produced by Clan Nova Cat expats. The modular weapons mount of the original were replaced with a Detachable Weapon Pack in each arm. The left arm carries a single AP Gauss Rifle while the right arm carries a LB-X (Battle Armor). Reflective armor protects the Thunderbird II. What makes it so deadly in the Republic Armed Forces is the integrated Battle Armor C3 system. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.955 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Thunderbird II 战斗装甲在希塔拉生产，供球体共和国使用，是新星猫氏族流亡者制造的 Thunderbird 战斗装甲升级版。原版的模块化武器挂点被替换为每条手臂一个可拆卸武器包。左臂携带一把 AP 高斯步枪，右臂携带一把 LB-X（战斗装甲）。反射装甲为 Thunderbird II 提供防护。它之所以在共和国武装部队中极其致命，靠的是集成式战斗装甲 C3 系统。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：0.955 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Grand Summoner is a Heavy Class Clan OmniMech which was first produced by Clan Jade Falcon during the early years of the thirty-second century. Initially produced by the Eagle Craft Group on Erewhon in the Inner Sphere, the Grand Summoner(also known by the Clan as the Grand Summoner) proved to be a highly reliable replacement for the original Thor OmniMech. The design would soon be traded among other Inner Sphere Clans and became popular among their Warrior castes. One of the 'Mech's most noted actions was during Clan Wolf's Trial of Possession for then Clan Diamond Shark's entire Swimmer Khanate’s Beta Aimag. The flotilla’s commanders were able to bid down the Clan Wolf commander to a Cluster’s worth of forces on the world of Feltre. The Grand Summoner's performance in the hands of Diamond Shark MechWarriors in this difficult terrain helped to turn the tide of battle and resulted in winning the Trial. Clan Jade Falcon first produced the Grand Summoner as a distinct symbol of honor. This 'Mech is painted yearly in the parade scheme of a unit chosen by the Clan's Khan as part of tradition of honoring Clusters who had performed services honoring the Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Grand Summoner 是一台重型氏族全能机甲，由玉衡鹰氏族于 32 世纪初首次生产。它最初由内天体埃里温的 Eagle Craft Group 制造，是原版 Thor 全能机甲的可靠替代品，很快在其他内天体氏族之间流通，并受到战士阶层欢迎。它最著名的行动之一，是狼氏族为争夺当时钻石鲨氏族整个游泳汗国 Beta Aimag 而发起的占有试炼。舰队指挥官在费尔特雷星球上成功迫使狼氏族指挥官将兵力出价压低到一个集群规模。钻石鲨机甲战士在恶劣地形中的出色表现扭转了战局，并赢得了试炼。玉衡鹰氏族最初制造 Grand Summoner，是将其作为荣誉象征。这台机甲每年都会涂成氏族可汗选定单位的阅兵涂装，以此纪念那些为氏族立下功劳的战斗集群。 特性：通信增强 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was the successor to the Infiltrator Mk. I, and while intended to fill a range of battlefield roles, it performed best as a scout or skirmisher. Nicknamed the Quokka, the Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was configured to be highly mobile and incorporated a Parafoil to allow it to make precise aerial drops. The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as being able to travel by mechanized transport. Each suit had a Basic Manipulator mounted on each arm and had more than a third of a ton of basic stealth armor for protection. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 灰蛾渗透装甲是渗透者 Mk. I 的后继型号。它原本要承担多种战场任务，但最擅长侦察和袭扰。灰蛾渗透装甲因酷似短尾矮袋鼠而被称为“Quokka”，采用高机动配置，并配备翼伞以进行精确空投。它能够发动群袭和断腿攻击，也可以通过机械化运输工具移动。每套装甲的双臂各安装一个基础操作器，并配有超过三分之一吨的基础隐形装甲。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

This armor, however, is standard stealth armor, so the Grenadier is a bit more difficult to target. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

column1: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Djinn 是已知最早的“恶魔系列”战斗装甲，由圣言之书为其人类主宰制造。Djinn 的设计目标就是让敌人心生恐惧。它纤细的外形显然是为人类主宰步兵量身打造的，因为他们的控制论强化弥补了“脆弱”的元素战士及其内天体对手操作战斗装甲所需的肌肉体格。 特性：凶悍 部署费用倍率：0.889 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Fenrir II Assault Battle Armor may have allegedly originated as the result of a bet between Archon Adam Steiner and Duke Vedet Brewer of Hesperus II, but Duke Brewer's vision of "a monstrous wolf straight from the nightmares of our ancestors" proved to be one of the most popular battle suits on the market after its introduction to service in 3119. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: Fenrir II 强袭战斗装甲据说源于亚当·施泰纳大公与赫斯珀洛斯 II 公爵韦代特·布鲁尔之间的一场赌局，但布鲁尔公爵所描述的“来自祖先噩梦的怪物巨狼”，在 3119 年投入服役后，确实成为市场上最受欢迎的战斗服之一。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 km/h and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Stealth 是联邦太阳和莱兰联盟使用的重型侦察机甲。它配备 GM 315 XL 引擎，速度可达 118.8 公里/小时；机载 MASC 系统还能在短时间内将速度推至 151.2 公里/小时。跳跃喷口进一步增强了它的机动性，使 Stealth 一次最多可跳跃 210 米。它还配备 Cyclops-Beagle 主动传感探测器，用于发现隐藏的敌方单位。 特性：传感器增强 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Templar III is a Dark Age era Assault Class OmniMech, first produced by General Motors for the Federated Suns. It was intended as a replacement for the original Templar, whose factory lines were destroyed during the Jihad. General Motors established a new production line on New Valencia for what was to become the next generation of the Templar with newer technologies. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Templar III 是黑暗时代的强袭级全能机甲，最初由通用汽车为联邦太阳生产。它原本要替代最初的 Templar，后者的生产线在圣战期间被摧毁。通用汽车在新瓦伦西亚建立了新的生产线，制造这款采用更新技术的下一代 Templar。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Kopis battle armor was designed by StarCorps Industries as an assault unit. Slow but heavily armed, the Kopis can remain on the battlefield supporting friendly units for a long time. The advanced armor used by the Kopis designers allows it to stand up to most weaponry, shrugging off anything short of a PPC or AC/10 hit. The low top speed is mitigated through the use of VTOL transportation for offensive operations, while smart commanders use the Kopis as a defense unit for cities or other tight terrain. In those restricted environments the low top speed isn't a factor. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Kopis 战斗装甲由星际军团工业设计为强袭单位。它速度缓慢但武装厚重，可以长时间留在战场上支援友军。Kopis 设计师采用的先进装甲足以抵挡大多数武器，除 PPC 或 AC/10 命中外几乎都能硬扛。低最高速度通过垂直起降运输弥补，用于进攻行动；而聪明的指挥官会把 Kopis 当作城市或狭窄地形中的防御单位。在这些受限环境里，低速并不构成问题。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Legacy was produced as a testbed for new technologies, including the Ultra AC/10 and C3i Computer, at the request of Word of Blake Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais. The designers used a failed Star League 'Mech called the Rising Star as the base for the Legacy. They upgraded its targeting system and included the C3i, which allows six units to coordinate fire. Its thick armor protection, standard fusion engine, and CASE give the Legacy remarkable staying power on the battlefield. One of the weaknesses of the 'Mech is its slow speed compared to other 'Mechs of similar size, but the inclusion of jump jets sought to counter that with superior maneuverability. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Legacy 由圣言之书军事主教卡梅伦·圣·贾梅斯要求制造，用作新技术试验平台，测试内容包括 Ultra AC/10 和 C3i 计算机。设计师以一台失败的星盟机甲 Rising Star 为基础打造 Legacy，升级其瞄准系统并加入 C3i，使六个单位能够协调火力。厚重装甲、标准聚变引擎和 C.A.S.E. 让 Legacy 在战场上拥有惊人的持久力。它的弱点是相比同体型机甲速度较慢，但跳跃喷口带来了更强机动性，部分弥补了这一缺陷。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: The Shedu is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series that is used exclusively by Manei Domini, one of the last of the Demons to be created by Precentor Vapula. Named for the half-bull, half-human demons of myth, the Shedu is an assault-class, quadrupedal battlesuit, a radical departure from the rest of the Demon line. The major advantage of the quad chassis is its speed, and Vapula used that to give the Shedu an excellent maximum ground speed for an assault-weight suit. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.904 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: Shedu 是圣言之书恶魔系列的战斗装甲，仅供人类主宰使用，也是瓦普拉军事主教制造的最后几种恶魔装甲之一。它以神话中半牛半人的恶魔命名，是一款强袭级四足战斗服，与恶魔系列其他型号截然不同。四足底盘最大的优势是速度，瓦普拉利用这一点，为 Shedu 赋予了强袭重量级装甲中极高的最高地面速度。 特性：凶悍 部署费用倍率：0.904 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.946 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 治安官镇压服由幽灵熊氏族推出，旨在帮助幽灵熊自治领维持内天体出生公民的秩序。幽灵熊守望队最初研发它，是为了对付一个名为 Motstånd 的拉萨哈格恐怖组织。装甲的武器和设备选项丰富，使守望队能够处理恐怖分子，同时避免动用全面军事化的警察力量伤害平民。守望队第一次使用该装甲时处理不当。后来将它出售给民用警察及其他组织，让守望队得以发展更少军事化的战术。如今它已经传播到其他氏族，以及龙辰联邦的内务安全部队和民事指导队等准军事组织。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.946 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. The Leonidas suit is highly configurable, capable of being reconfigured for various battlefield missions including providing positional information, calling in artillery strikes, waging counterinsurgency warfare and conducting ambushes; the various roles are made possible through the different weapons and equipment loadouts available via the Modular Weapon Mount. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Leonidas 战斗装甲由埃特纳铸造厂制造，原本用于弥补东方公国武装部队的能力缺口；这一缺口源于老式 Achileus 隐形装甲稀缺。Leonidas 高度可配置，能够针对不同战场任务重新调整，包括提供阵地信息、呼叫炮击、执行反叛乱行动和实施伏击。模块化武器挂点提供了多种武器与设备配置，使这些任务成为可能。 特性：信息收集 部署费用倍率：0.89 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。
