column1: The brainchild of Dr. Stephen Vance, Tortoise II Battle Armor was an assault-class quad battle armor developed by the Republic of the Sphere. It was a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies utilized by the Republic which was costly for StarCorps Industries of Terra to develop due to the unique design features Dr. Vance incorporated into it. Dr. Vance utilized wheels instead of rear legs to help the design carry its twin weapons modules onto the battlefield. Nicknamed the "Wheelbarrow", the original Tortoise prototype was a money pit. After a redesign and technology purchase from Arc-Royal MechWorks, the new Tortoise II proved to be successful despite its critics. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: Tortoise II 战斗装甲由斯蒂芬·万斯博士构想，是球体共和国研发的强袭级四足战斗装甲。它融合共和国采用的内天体与氏族技术；由于万斯博士加入了独特设计特征，开发成本让 Terra 的星际军团工业不堪重负。万斯博士用轮子取代后腿，让它能够将两组武器模块运上战场。最初的 Tortoise 原型被戏称为“独轮车”，是个吞金黑洞。重新设计并从 Arc-Royal 机甲工坊购入技术后，新型 Tortoise II 尽管饱受质疑，最终仍获得成功。 特性：实验性设计 部署费用倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Combining the role of IFV and Light Tank, the Kamisori is a Republic era Light Tank produced by Pesht Motors. Designed to work in conjunction with Battle Armor whilst bring the firepower of a Galleon the Kamisori is a 20 ton Omni Tank. Powered by a 120-rated fusion core, the Kamisori can reach speeds of 97 km/h and is protected by 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor. A 5 ton allocation of pod space in the turret allows for a diverse range of variants. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 150 10 Left 100 10 Right 100 10 Rear 55 10 Turret 145 10 Total 550 50 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Omni Vehicle
column2: Kamisori 兼具步兵战车和轻型坦克的作用，是共和时代由佩什特汽车制造的轻型坦克。它的设计目标是在支援战斗装甲的同时，提供与 Galleon 相当的火力；这台 20 吨全能坦克由 120 级聚变核心驱动，速度可达 97 公里/小时，并以 5.5 吨重型 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲提供防护。炮塔内 5 吨挂载舱空间可容纳多种配置。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米。 装甲：重型 Ferro-Fibrous 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 150 10 左侧 100 10 右侧 100 10 后方 55 10 炮塔 145 10 总计 550 50 特性：精准武器 - 能量 全能载具

column1: Considered a by-gone design by the time of the Reunification Wars, the Icarus II rarely crossed paths with the Star League Defense Force and was not even much of an afterthought after the Exodus to Clan Space. This fairly unremarkable history made the shock of the Icarus IIC's appearance that much more shocking. This Omni-Mech redesign was proposed to both Jade Falcon and Steel Viper leadership who rejected it outright. However, the design survived and evolved thanks to a few Society cells. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 统一战争时期，Icarus II 已被视为过时设计，很少与星盟防卫军交手；人类大迁徙至氏族空间后，它甚至没留下多少印象。正因历史平淡无奇，Icarus IIC 的出现才更加令人震惊。这种全能机甲改型曾同时提交给玉衡鹰氏族和钢蛇氏族高层，却被断然拒绝。然而，少数“社团”细胞让设计得以幸存并不断演化。 特性：短程瞄准增强 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Based on the King Crab, and built in the same factory that first produced the Mackie, the Vanquisher has a legendary pedigree. The Vanquisher has its genesis in the development of reverse engineered Improved C3 Computers. Once the Word of Blake had perfected their version of C3i, Cameron St. Jamais contacted Skobel MechWorks and contracted them to produce a 'Mech that would showcase the features of the new system. The Vanquisher was the result of that request. In order to allow it to carry as heavy a payload as possible without sacrificing durability, the 'Mech is built on a Hollis Alteration Mark VI Endo Steel that carries a Vlar 300 fusion engine, which propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 54 km/h. The Vanquisher is protected by nineteen and a half tons of armor with CASE in both side torsos to protect the 'Mech from going down in an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Vanquisher 以 King Crab 为基础，并在最初生产 Mackie 的同一座工厂制造，拥有传奇血统。它源自逆向工程改进型 C3 计算机的研发。圣言之书完善 C3i 版本后，卡梅伦·圣·贾梅斯联系斯科贝尔机甲工坊，委托他们制造一台展示新系统功能的机甲，Vanquisher 就此诞生。为尽可能携带重型载荷而不牺牲耐久性，它采用 Hollis Alteration Mark VI 内骨骼，搭载 Vlar 300 聚变引擎，最高速度可达 54 公里/小时。Vanquisher 由 19.5 吨装甲保护，两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，防止弹药爆炸导致机甲瘫痪。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 治安官镇压服由幽灵熊氏族推出，旨在帮助幽灵熊自治领维持内天体出生公民的秩序。幽灵熊守望队最初研发它，是为了对付一个名为 Motstånd 的拉萨哈格恐怖组织。装甲的武器和设备选项丰富，使守望队能够处理恐怖分子，同时避免动用全面军事化的警察力量伤害平民。守望队第一次使用该装甲时处理不当。后来将它出售给民用警察及其他组织，让守望队得以发展更少军事化的战术。如今它已经传播到其他氏族，以及龙辰联邦的内务安全部队和民事指导队等准军事组织。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.9475 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The ultralight OmniMech Celerity was initially ComStar's attempt at creating an expendable drone reconnaissance BattleMech right after the Battle of Tukayyid. After the Fortress Protocols were activated, the Republic of the Sphere began experimenting with the Celerity as a means of expanding its military technology. They created a true OmniMech version of the Celerity to expand upon its utility and used it extensively on raids across their borders in the Dark Age era, causing endless confusion as to the identity of the parties using them.
column2: 轻量级全能机甲 Celerity 最初是 ComStar 在图卡伊德战役后尝试制造的一次性无人侦察战斗机甲。堡垒协议启动后，球体共和国开始试验 Celerity，希望借此扩展自身军事技术。他们制造了真正的 Celerity 全能机甲版本，进一步发挥其用途，并在黑暗时代大规模用于边境袭扰，令外界始终无法确定究竟是哪一方在使用它们。

column1: The King Dragon is a new addition to the roster of 'Mechs fielded by House Kurita in the Inner Sphere. Developed by the well-known manufacturer, Takara Tomy, this 'Mech was a massive upgrade over the 60-ton Dragon - both considering firepower and survivability. With its imposing size and heavily reinforced armor, the King Dragon was designed to fill the role of the ultimate heavy-hitter on the battlefield, a true Dreadnought. Despite its massive size, the King Dragon is surprisingly agile thanks to its highly balance chassis, making it a formidable opponent even for lighter and more nimble 'Mechs. This agility, combined with its advanced targeting systems and unparalleled firepower, makes the King Dragon a fearsome sight on any battlefield. The King Dragon quickly gained a reputation as one of the most fearsome and unstoppable Superheavy BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere and pilots of the 'Mech quickly became legendary figures in the various wars and conflicts that wracked the region, inspiring awe and fear in equal measure. Overall, the King Dragon is a testament to the engineering prowess of Takara Tomy and the relentless pursuit of new and improved designs to bring to the battlefield.
column2: King Dragon 是内天体库里的一款新机型，由库里塔家族部署。它由知名制造商 Takara Tomy 开发，相比 60 吨的 Dragon，在火力和生存能力上都有巨大提升。凭借压迫感十足的体型和加厚装甲，King Dragon 被设计为战场上的终极重击者，是真正的无畏舰。尽管体型庞大，它高度平衡的底盘让它出人意料地灵活，即使面对更轻、更敏捷的机甲也毫不逊色。再加上先进瞄准系统和无与伦比的火力，King Dragon 在任何战场上都令人胆寒。它很快成为内天体最可怕、最难以阻挡的超重型战斗机甲之一，驾驶员也在当地接连不断的战争与冲突中成为传奇人物，令人敬畏又恐惧。总体而言，King Dragon 证明了 Takara Tomy 的工程实力，以及其不断追求新设计、改进战场装备的决心。

column1: The Centurion OmniMech was born out of a desire on the part of Corean Enterprises to expand the company's market share. Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries.
column2: Centurion 全能机甲源于 Corean Enterprises 扩大市场份额的愿望。它主要在新亚法隆的 Corean Enterprises 工厂生产，重 50 吨，配备 Magna 250 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 86 公里/小时，并装有 9.5 吨标准装甲。十个固定式双重散热器为 Centurion 提供了 24 吨挂载舱空间，几乎占机甲总重量的一半；它的常见变体也延续了几个世纪以来原始 Centurion 战斗机甲的不同配置。

column1: When the news of Precentor Vapula's Celestial series of 'Mechs reached Precentor Destral VII, he refused to have his devotion be outdone. Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and armor, such as the Exsecratio Stealth Armor and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.
column2: 当瓦普拉军事主教的天体系列机甲传到德斯特拉尔七世军事主教耳中时，他拒绝让自己的信仰被比下去。他把一切可用和不可用的资源都投入其中，设计团队最终打造出 Leliorium——一台重 200 吨的全能机甲。它的名字取自《所罗门之钥》中地位最高的恶魔，对应天体系列的天使。为了进一步说明这些并非单纯强化版天体机甲，每种配置都以九位恶魔之王中的一位命名。每台机甲都使用 Exsecratio 隐形装甲、Seraphim 电子战套件等最前沿的实验武器与装甲。每台机甲出厂前的最后一道检查，是由六名高级布莱克牧师进行神圣祝福，确保驾驶员和机甲都受到布莱克庇佑。

column1: You mull over everything Howe Zeng has just outlined to you, while glancing through the precise data on the noteputer. As you hand the noteputer back to Darius, you turn towards Howe, "Thank you for this information. I think we will go with the Standard Package. We are on a budget, but not one that puts higher risk at a lower cost. Darius, make the arrangements." Darius nods as he escorts Mr Zeng back to her DropShip, "Understood, Commander" GAMMA POD UPGRADE UNLOCKED VISIT ENGINEERING TO BEGIN UPGRADE CONSTRUCTION
column2: 你一边查看记事终端上精确的数据，一边琢磨何青刚才向你说明的一切。你把终端还给达利乌斯，转向何青：“谢谢你的信息。我想我们会选择标准套餐。预算确实有限，但不会为了降低成本而承担更高风险。达利乌斯，安排下去。” 达利乌斯护送曾先生回运输船，点头道：“明白，指挥官。” 伽马舱升级已解锁 请前往工程部开始建造升级

column1: Created to tap into the burgeoning market for combat vehicles in the post Blackout Inner Sphere, the 30 ton Onuris is an Omni adaption of the Anhur Assault Transport. Developed and sold by the Sea Foxes, the Onuris is covered powered by a 100-rated XL Engine augmented by a Jet Booster, giving it a top speed in excess of 160 km/h. 6 tons of Reflective armor and Clan standard CASE provide protection whilst a massive 14 tons of pod space allows for a wide variety of configurations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Glazed (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 15 Left 120 15 Right 120 15 Rear 100 15 Total 535 75 Quirk: Quick Off The Line Omni Vehicle
column2: Onuris 为进军黑幕事件后的内天体战斗载具市场而设计，是 Anhur 强袭运输车的全能改型。这台 30 吨全能载具由海狐氏族研发并销售，采用 100 级 XL 引擎并加装喷气助推器，最高速度超过 160 公里/小时。6 吨反射装甲和氏族标准 C.A.S.E. 提供防护，巨大的 14 吨挂载舱空间则支持多种配置。 生物群系限制：无法部署于月面生物群系。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 装甲：镀层（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 180 15 左侧 120 15 右侧 120 15 后方 100 15 总计 535 75 特性：快速出击 全能载具

column1: A midweight MBT developed by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja has since spread throughout the homeworld clans. A 55 ton Omni-Tank, the Naja is armoured in 14 tons of Ferro Lamellor and powered by a 330 rated XXL Engine giving it 19.5 tons of pod space. Known variants include: A pair of iATM-9s with Improved Heavy Medium and Small Lasers augmented by a Targeting Computer, an ATM-6 paired with a TC augmented ER Large Pulse Laser, a HG/30 paired with an ER Medium Pulse Laser and lastly 3 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers and an IH Small Laser all tied to a TC and a Light Active Probe. Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Endo-Steel (C) Values A S Front 275 30 Left 215 30 Right 215 30 Rear 150 30 Turret 200 30 Total 1055 150 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms
column2: Naja 是云蛇氏族研发的中型主战坦克，如今已传播到各个氏族母星。它是一台 55 吨全能坦克，配备 14 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲和 330 级 XXL 引擎，拥有 19.5 吨挂载舱空间。已知配置包括：两台 iATM-9，配合改进型重型中型激光、小型激光和瞄准计算机；一台 ATM-6，配合由瞄准计算机增强的 ER 大型脉冲激光；一台 HG/30，配合 ER 中型脉冲激光；以及三门改进型重型中型激光和一门 IH 小型激光，全部连接到瞄准计算机和轻型主动探测器。经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：Ferro-Lamellor（氏族） 结构：内骨骼（氏族） 数值 A S 正面 275 30 左侧 215 30 右侧 215 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 1055 150 特性：机构防护

column1: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 它基于标准净化者战斗装甲，主要区别是移除了拟态装甲，换成与元素战士装甲相同的氏族标准装甲。Purifier Terra 使用模块化武器挂点，提供多种武器选择。联军曾遭遇装备氏族级 ER 小型激光、小型脉冲激光和 AP 高斯步枪的变体，另一些变体使用中型无后坐力步枪。除此之外，只要能装进 400 千克模块化武器挂点的设备都可以携带。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.868 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1:
Shaking your head, you say, "Chief, I can't afford to have half of your technicians in the MedBay. You do remember last time don't you?" Turning to your XO, "Darius, spread the word and see what you can sell them for."

Darius checks in a few days later. "Sorry, Commander. I haven't gotten any bites yet. Honestly, though, I don't think we can sell them now. Not in good conscience anyway."

Later that week in the mess hall, disgruntlement ripples through the room. Rumors about the lost shipment have apparently begun to spread.
column2:
你摇摇头：“老杨，我可承担不起让你一半的技术员都进医务室。你还记得上次吧？”你转向副官：“达利乌斯，把消息散出去，看看能卖多少钱。”

几天后，达利乌斯回来汇报：“抱歉，指挥官。暂时还没人接手。不过说实话，我觉得现在卖不出去。至少从良心上说不行。”

那周晚些时候，餐厅里怨声四起。关于那批丢失货物的传闻显然已经开始传播。

column1: Shaking your head, you say, "Chief, I can't afford to have half of your technicians in the MedBay. Rember last time?" Turning to your XO, "Darius, spread the word and see what you can sell them for." Later that week, Darius delivers unexpectedly good news. "You won't believe this, Commander. A mercenary company from Liao space had a clause in their contract that their monthly pay would include meals at a Taco Truck. Their XO was desperate to take the mince off our hands, to stave off a mutiny because the closest one was outside of their contract zone." Yang slams his fist on the table. "See! Maybe next we will get to enjoy those tacos!"
column2: 你摇摇头：“老杨，我可承担不起让你一半的技术员都进医务室。还记得上次吗？”你转向副官：“达利乌斯，把消息散出去，看看能卖多少钱。” 那周晚些时候，达利乌斯带来了意外的好消息：“指挥官，你绝对想不到。来自辽空间的一家雇佣兵公司，合同里写明每月薪酬包含在塔可餐车用餐。他们的副官急着接手这些肉馅，好避免兵变，因为最近的餐车在合同区域之外。” 杨一拳砸在桌上：“看吧！说不定下次我们也能吃上那些塔可！”

column1: The Balar was designed by Luthien Armor Works and released alongside the Avatar as a competitor to the Inner Sphere's first OmniMech design. While the Avatar was based upon the clan's Vulture OmniMech, the Balar took cues from the Ebon Jaguar instead. Sporting an impressive 350-rated XL fusion engine, the Balar was fast for a 70-ton 'Mech, but prohibitively expensive, which ultimately caused the design to be mostly overlooked by Combine procurement agents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 巴拉尔由卢希恩装甲工坊设计，与阿凡达一同发布，作为内天体第一款全能机甲设计的竞争者。阿凡达基于氏族的秃鹫全能机甲，而巴拉尔则借鉴了黑豹。它配备强大的 350 级 XL 聚变引擎，对于 70 吨的巴拉尔机甲而言速度很快，但成本高得令人望而却步，最终大部分联邦采购人员都忽略了这项设计。 特性：窄体/低轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Deployed by the Homeworld Clans as a fast harasser and recon tank, the Kefira is a lightweight and heavily armoured Omni-Tank. A 175 XL Engine pushes the Kefira to speeds of 150 kph and 7.5 tons of Ferro Lamellor armour allow it to shrug off absurd levels of firepower for its small size. Known variants include: 3 ER Medium Lasers tied to a targeting computer, an ER Large Pulse model, dual ERML and an iATM-9 and lastly dual Improved Heavy Medium Lasers tied to a TC with an Angel ECM suit and Active Probe.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 160 20 Left 120 20 Right 120 20 Rear 95 20 Turret 100 20 Total 595 100 Quirk: Agile
column2: Kefira 由氏族母星部署，作为快速骚扰与侦察坦克。这是一台轻型但装甲厚重的全能坦克，175 XL 引擎将速度推至 150 公里/小时，7.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲让它以小体型承受荒谬程度的火力。已知配置包括：三门连接瞄准计算机的 ER 中型激光、ER 大型脉冲激光型号、双 ERML 配合一台 iATM-9，以及双改进型重型中型激光连接瞄准计算机并搭载天使 ECM 套件和主动探测器。经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：11/17 格 / 330/510 米。 装甲：Ferro-Lamellor（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 160 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 95 20 炮塔 100 20 总计 595 100 特性：灵活

column1: Superheavy 'Mechs were often considered nothing more than a pipe-dream. So when the Wars of Reaving began and the Society's Hyperion strode onto the battlefield, Clan leadership was rightfully troubled. Built using the latest technologies available, the Hyperion can keep pace with many Assault 'Mechs while carrying substantially more armor and more pod-space. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 超重型机甲常被认为不过是白日梦。因此，当掠夺战争爆发、社团的 Hyperion 踏上战场时，氏族高层理所当然地感到不安。Hyperion 采用当时最先进的技术，能够跟上许多强袭机甲，同时携带更多装甲和挂载舱空间。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.3 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Developed as a civilian cargo vehicle and subsequently pressed into service as an improvised combat vehicle, the Tobruk is a 5 ton raiding unit developed by resistance fighters on Azha. Powered by a 25 rated Fusion Engine and carrying a paltry ton of armour, the Tobruk relies on speed and firepower to survive a fight. Known variants include an ER Small Laser/Rocket combo, triple ER Small Laser, dual Machine Gun and lastly an ER Medium Laser model.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 30 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 15 5 Turret 30 5 Total 115 25 Quirk: Improved Communications
column2: Tobruk 原本是民用货运车，后来被改征为临时战斗载具。这台 5 吨突袭单位由阿扎的抵抗战士研发，配备 25 级聚变引擎，却只有可怜的 1 吨装甲，因此依靠速度和火力求生。已知配置包括 ER 小型激光/火箭组合、三门 ER 小型激光、两挺机枪，以及 ER 中型激光型号。经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 30 5 左侧 20 5 右侧 20 5 后方 15 5 炮塔 30 5 总计 115 25 特性：通信增强

column1: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Efficient Motive System Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: Rottweiler 设计为战斗装甲部队的快速步行侦察兵，将地面速度推向战斗装甲所能达到的极限。它披挂战斗装甲级隐形装甲并配备 ECM，很难被锁定。但速度和闪避能力是有代价的：Rottweiler 火力很轻。每套装甲以一门小型激光为主武器，并携带一把 Firedrake 燃烧针枪作为备用武器。虽然火力不强，莱兰联盟仍认为这足以接受，并将其投入生产。 特性：高效动力系统 部署费用倍率：0.888 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Originally developed in the thirty-second century as a replacement for the Raiden suit, the Oni was considered an ugly and generally unimpressive battlesuit by the majority of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery, and was generally issued to either garrison units or units suffering the disfavor of the Procurement Department. Despite the problems with the Oni - perceived or actual - the suit has continued to be a presence in militia units throughout the first half of the thirty-second century, in part because of the third of a ton of Clan-spec fire resistant armor the Oni mounts. The Oni also mounts both an Extended Life Support system and an ECM Suite, and is also capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as serving as a mechanized unit. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Oni 最初于 32 世纪研发，用来替代 Raiden 战斗服。龙辰联邦大多数征召军认为它外形丑陋、性能平庸，因此通常配发给驻军单位，或配给不受军需部门待见的部队。无论 Oni 的问题是实际存在还是仅仅被这样看待，它仍在 32 世纪前半叶持续出现在民兵部队中，部分原因是它配备了三分之一吨的氏族规格耐火装甲。Oni 还搭载延寿生命维持系统和 ECM 套件，能够发动群袭与断腿攻击，也可以作为机械化单位运用。 特性：直觉控制 部署费用倍率：0.868 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Oh man Boss, this thing is a dream to work on. Those Coyote scientists included all the design schematics, ammunition formulas, everything to make the mech, in multiple redundant data storage spots located around the mech. The spacious room to do maintenance is something I haven't seen since an Orion, and I feel totally fine handing it over to the newbie mechtechs, because it's just so idiot proof (knock on wood).  They even engraved the wiring schematics into the mech's frame! Heck, I'd even let Darius try repairing it! Ok, no, I wouldn't, because somehow he'd find some hostile BA in a leg or something and we'd have a fight inside the Argo, but you know what I mean.
column2: 老杨，这东西简直是我的梦中情机！那些郊狼科学家把所有设计图、弹药公式，以及制造这台机甲所需的一切资料，都以多份冗余形式存进了机甲周围的数据存储点。宽敞的维护空间是我自 Orion 以来从未见过的，我完全放心把它交给新手技师，因为它实在太不容易被修坏了（敲敲木头）。他们甚至把线路图直接蚀刻在机甲骨架上！说真的，我甚至会让达利乌斯试着修它！好吧，不会，因为他肯定会在某条腿里找到敌对战斗装甲之类的东西，然后我们就得在阿耳戈号里面打起来，但你懂我的意思。

column1: The Manx is a ComStar design for an heavy impact superheavy based around Rotary Autocannons of various sizes and types. At 170 ton and using all the weight saving technology there is, an impressive amount of weapons can be fit on the chassis. The arm and shoulder actuators are strengthened to allow for reduction of the weapon recoil. Even the sensor and piloting equipment are top notch, the combination of Vehicular DNI, Angel ECM, Bloodhound Probe and a C3i unit making it near impossible to not perform well with the 'Mech on the battlefield.
column2: Manx 是 ComStar 设计的重型冲击型超重型机甲，以各种尺寸和类型的旋转自动炮为核心。它重 170 吨，并使用所有可用的减重技术，因此底盘能安装惊人的武器数量。手臂和肩部执行器经过强化，可降低武器后坐力。就连传感器和驾驶设备也都是顶级配置：载具 DNI、天使 ECM、猎犬探测器和 C3i 单元结合在一起，让这台机甲几乎不可能在战场上表现不佳。

column1: Created out of scraps of Society tech left from the Wars of the Reaving, the Dugite is Clan Star Adders contribution to the Homeworld Clans. A 100 ton Omni-Tank, the Dugite is designed to take on the assault weight Mechs and win. A 300 xxl engine powers the tank and 24.5 tons of Ferro Lamellor provide heavy protection. 50.5 tons of podspace allow for a lot of firepower. Known variants include: 6 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers tied to a Targeting Computer with a Light TAG/Angel ECM/Active Probe/Laser AMS, 2 HAG/20s paired with an iATM-12 and 2 IHMLs supported by an AMS and a TC, 4 iATM-12s and 2 IHMLs tied toa TC with an Angel ECM Suite; and lastly 2 HAG/40s with the expected TC and 2 ER Medium Lasers.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters.
